profile.headline:
Senior Web Developer | WordPress, Shopify, Performance & SEO
 | Partner at Chameleon Collective
profile.jobTitle: Senior Web Developer & Partner | Wordpress & Shopify
profile.summary: Victoria Martinez is an experienced Web Developer with 20 years of expertise across WordPress, WooCommerce, Shopify, and custom web solutions. Known for delivering clean, scalable, and thoughtfully built websites, she brings a balance of technical precision, strategic insight, and creative problem-solving to every project. Victoria specializes in full-site redevelopments, SEO best practices, privacy compliance guidance (including GDPR), and performance optimization, always with a focus on usability and flexibility so clients and their teams can confidently manage and grow their websites long after launch. Whether navigating complex product structures in Shopify or improving content workflows and site architecture in WordPress, she approaches each project with care, clarity, and a collaborative mindset. With deep development expertise and a background in design, Victoria brings a critical eye and actionable recommendations to support strong visual execution while leading with clean, maintainable code. She also has experience with Google Tag Manager (GTM), analytics and tracking setup, HubSpot and CRM integrations, and subscription solutions like Recharge. As part of the Collective OS network, Victoria thrives in collaborative environments where great work is done efficiently and thoughtfully across disciplines. She is passionate about empowering clients, not just launching websites, but setting them up with the tools, knowledge, and structure to support ongoing success.

positions.title: Senior Web Developer & Partner | Wordpress & Shopify
positions.description:
We grow companies.

Our Collective solves challenges across business, brand, product, executive recruiting, and technology. We have developed a flat, flexible, and efficient model that allows us to support our clients by providing top-down leadership that drives change and accelerates growth, subject matter experts that can execute challenging tasks, and the ability to find and help build top-tier in-house teams through our network.

We believe our approach is the future of work. We have reinvented the traditional company by removing traditional hierarchies, unnecessary costs, and a business model that breed inflexibility. Our approach attracts multi-disciplinary leaders and entrepreneurial free thinkers that self-manage and solve meaningful challenges for our clients. The approach that sparked our company will revolutionize yours.

positions.title: Freelance Web Designer and Web Developer
positions.description:
Freelance Web Designer and Web Developer for multiple websites. 
Experience in development from the ground up, including the setting up of domain and hosting, to custom coding websites for specific functionality. Re-design of existing websites, and migration to new platforms. I specialize on Wordpress/WooCommerce and Joomla.

I am an experienced Admin who can actively manage your domains and hosting, and find the best solution for your needs. I have migrated many websites, including my most complex project, recovering a forum with over 10 years of posts and successfully migrating its massive database. 

I design websites that are clean and modern, and reflect my client's unique brand. My designs are fully responsive and mobile ready, user friendly with easy navigation, custom made for each of my clients, fully integrated to social media, and fully optimized for search engines (SEO)

In addition to integrating your brand to social media,  I also provide invaluable advice on how to improve your internet presence, including but not limited to improving your Google Business Listing, Facebook Business page, easy but successful promotional ideas, and how to optimize your mailing list.

Specialties: HTML5, CSS3, PHP, CMS, Wordpress, WooCommerce, PSD to Wordpress, Joomla, OSCommerce, Prestashop , mySQL, phpBB, e-commerce, integrating Social media including: Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, Flickr and Youtube, Google My Business Page,  Admin, Domain and Hosting, Google Search Console, Google Analytics, Google Adwords, CDN support and setup, SSL setup for secure websites

positions.title: Graphic Designer
positions.description:
As a graphic designer, I am proficient in the Adobe Design Suite, and have designed both digital and print media. I have designed business cards, brochures, product packaging, and print ads for local, national, and international publications. I also design special events signage, including promotional banners, posters, a-frames, truss designs, start/finish lines for races, and scoreboard graphics.

Specialities: Web graphics, Logo design, Photoshop, Illustrator, photo re-touching, video editing, print ads, design ads, design brochures, posters, special events signage, scoreboard graphics, product packaging

volunteerExperiences.role: Graphic Designer for Annual Walgreens DRI Walk
volunteerExperiences.description: Design and layout of posters, event banners, Start/Finish Line, trusses, sponsor banners and scoreboard graphics for the annual Diabetes Research Institute Walk for Diabetes & Family Fun Day Presented by Walgreens (2012-2019). One of their biggest fundraising events each year.
